doc: compare(gen, ref) from the two measure dicts (inputs: gen_zonal_lat, gen_zonal, gen_hist and ref_zonal_lat, ref_zonal, ref_hist, the keys of measure()): zonal_rmse = sqrt(mean((gen.zonal - ref.zonal)^2)) over the bands with |gen.zonal_lat| < 70 (strict; the latitudes come from the GENERATED dict and ref_zonal_lat is never read), hist_l1 = sum |gen.hist - ref.hist|; returned here as [zonal_rmse, hist_l1]. Float64 arithmetic on lists: 1e-9. Latitudes just outside, exactly on and just inside +-70: -80, -70.001, -70 and 70, 70.001, 80 are excluded (strict <), only -69.999, 0, 69.999 count: rmse = sqrt((0.4^2 + 0.2^2 + 0.2^2) / 3) = 0.2828; hist_l1 = 0.6.
